lcc_original: 地還沒有定形、混混沌沌；黑暗在深淵上面；上帝的靈覆煦在水面上。
notes: LCC '還沒有定形' collapses two Hebrew words into one phrase — H1961 (הָיְתָה, was) + H8414 (תֹהוּ, formless); both tags appended at end of phrase with morphology <WTH8804> kept adjacent to H1961.
UNV's implicit {<WAH05921>} (עַל) becomes explicit 在 in LCC due to word order inversion (UNV: 淵面黑暗 vs. LCC: 黑暗在深淵上面); braces dropped per Rule 3.
In '在深淵上面': 在 = H5921 (עַל, upon), 深淵 = H8415 (תְהֹום, deep), 上面 = H6440 (פְּנֵי, face/surface).
LCC 上帝 = UNV 神 = H430 (אֱלֹהִים); LCC 覆煦 = UNV 運行 = H7363 (מְרַחֶפֶת, hovering/brooding).
